# Estora

> Luxury Real Estate Discovery & Scheduling Platform

Estora is a modern web application facilitating luxury property discovery, AI-powered semantic search, property comparison, and lead generation.

## Key Pages
- [Home & Discover](https://estora-realestate.vercel.app/): Explore all verified luxury real estate listings.
- [Properties](https://estora-realestate.vercel.app/properties): Search and filter listings by location, price, bedrooms, and amenities.
- [Projects](https://estora-realestate.vercel.app/projects): New developments and master-planned communities.
- [Agents](https://estora-realestate.vercel.app/agents): Directory of certified luxury real estate agents.
- [Services](https://estora-realestate.vercel.app/services): Valuation, investment advisory, and property listing.
- [About](https://estora-realestate.vercel.app/about): Company overview and mission.
- [Contact](https://estora-realestate.vercel.app/contact): Contact form and agent assistance.

## Capabilities
- AI-Powered Semantic Search powered by Google Gemini API.
- Side-by-side comparison matrix for up to 3 properties.
- Dynamic Mortgage & EMI Calculator.
- Direct site visit scheduling (in-person or virtual).
